system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

At this point in your career. You’ve seen it all. Your enemies strategies aren’t new or inventive. You haven’t struggled to find a solution in a long time and it’s become boring. What a drag, right?

You can set up 1 Contingency at the start of your turn, without spending a bonus action. If you do, you cannot spend a Bonus action to establish a Contingency.

You can use Shadow Possession as a Bonus action instead of an Action. If you do, you cannot use Shadow Possession as an Action.
